description: This Java class, XmlWidgetFieldVisitor, generates XML representations of various widget model fields for the Apache OFBiz framework. It implements visitor methods for different widget types to produce corresponding XML snippets, handling attributes, nested elements, and references to external resources.

classes.name: XmlWidgetFieldVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses widget model fields and generates corresponding XML representations, handling numerous widget types with specific attribute and nested element logic.

methods.name: visit(CheckField)
methods.description: Generates XML for a checkbox widget, including attributes and nested options.

methods.name: visit(ContainerField)
methods.description: Handles XML generation for container fields.

methods.name: visit(DateFindField)
methods.description: Creates XML for date find fields with date-specific attributes.

methods.name: visit(DateTimeField)
methods.description: Generates XML representation for date/time fields with relevant attributes.

methods.name: visit(DisplayEntityField)
methods.description: Produces XML for display-entity fields, including cache, entity name, and current key.

methods.name: visit(DisplayField)
methods.description: Creates XML for display fields.

methods.name: visit(DropDownField)
methods.description: Handles XML creation for dropdown list fields, including options and autocomplete.

methods.name: visit(FileField)
methods.description: Generates XML for file upload fields.

methods.name: visit(HiddenField)
methods.description: Creates XML for hidden input fields.

methods.name: visit(HyperlinkField)
methods.description: Generates XML for hyperlink fields with link attributes and optional nested images.

methods.name: visit(FormField)
methods.description: Handles including a form widget by its name and location.

methods.name: visit(GridField)
methods.description: Includes grid widgets in XML by name and location.

methods.name: visit(MenuField)
methods.description: Includes menu widgets.

methods.name: visit(ScreenField)
methods.description: Includes screen references.

methods.name: visit(IgnoredField)
methods.description: Generates minimal XML for ignored fields.

methods.name: visit(ImageField)
methods.description: Generates XML for image fields with attributes and optional hyperlink.

methods.name: visit(LookupField)
methods.description: Creates XML for lookup fields with search-specific attributes.

methods.name: visit(PasswordField)
methods.description: Generates XML for password input fields.

methods.name: visit(RadioField)
methods.description: Produces XML for radio button groups.

methods.name: visit(RangeFindField)
methods.description: Creates XML for range-find fields with from and thru options.

methods.name: visit(ResetField)
methods.description: Generates minimal XML for reset fields.

methods.name: visit(SubmitField)
methods.description: Includes submit button widget with various button attributes.

methods.name: visit(TextareaField)
methods.description: Creates XML for textarea inputs with size, read-only, and default value options.

methods.name: visit(TextField)
methods.description: Generates XML for text input fields, including autocomplete and placeholder attributes.

methods.name: visit(TextFindField)
methods.description: Creates XML for text search fields with default options and ignore case.
